fullPassage: Recently, a study was conducted on the difference in pain tolerance between athletes and non-athletes. The results showed that the athletes were able to tolerate higher levels of pain. According to the researchers, this is because they make use of certain cognitive strategies to deal with the pain. For example, some athletes are immersed so deeply in the physical act they are performing that they are able to ignore the pain. As athletes are often incredibly motivated to win a game or set a record in their event, they seem to be more likely to adopt these techniques.

questions.passage: Recently, a study was conducted on the difference in pain tolerance between athletes and non-athletes. The results showed that the athletes were able to tolerate __________ (high) levels of pain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 운동선수가 비운동선수보다 '더 높은' 수준을 견딜 수 있다는 비교의 맥락이므로 비교급이 필요하다. high의 비교급은 higher이다.
det.analysis: the athletes were able to tolerate __________ (high) levels → 두 집단을 비교하여 '더 높은' 수준을 견딘다는 의미 → 비교급 higher

questions.passage: Another strategy is one in which athletes focus on a positive thought to distract them from negative feelings of pain. The researchers believe that this kind of resistance to pain is something that can be __________ (learn) over time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 조동사 can 다음에 be가 있고 '학습될 수 있다'는 수동의 의미이므로, be + 과거분사 형태가 필요하다. learn의 과거분사는 learned이다.
det.analysis: can be __________ (learn) over time → '학습될 수 있다'는 수동태 → 「be + 과거분사」 → learned

questions.passage: Recently, a study was conducted on the difference in pain tolerance between athletes and non-athletes. The results showed that the athletes were able to tolerate higher levels of pain. According to the researchers, this is because they make use of certain cognitive strategies to deal with the pain. For example, some athletes are immersed so deeply in the physical act they are performing that they are able to __________. Another strategy is one in which athletes focus on a positive thought to distract them from negative feelings of pain. The researchers believe that this kind of resistance to pain is something that can be learned over time. As athletes are often incredibly motivated to win a game or set a record in their event, they seem to be more likely to adopt these techniques.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 일부 선수는 수행 중인 신체 활동에 깊이 몰입한 나머지 '고통을 무시할' 수 있다는 내용이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① lose their focus(집중을 잃다) — 깊이 몰입한다는 흐름과 반대
✅ ② ignore the pain(고통을 무시하다) — 몰입으로 고통을 잊는다는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ③ feel every ache(모든 통증을 느끼다) — 고통을 무시하는 것과 반대
❌ ④ stop the game(경기를 멈추다) — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: immersed so deeply … able to ignore the pain = 깊이 몰입해 고통을 무시함

questions.passage: Recently, a study was conducted on the difference in pain tolerance between athletes and non-athletes. The results showed that the athletes were able to tolerate higher levels of pain. According to the researchers, this is because they make use of certain cognitive strategies to deal with the pain. For example, some athletes are immersed so deeply in the physical act they are performing that they are able to ignore the pain. Another strategy is one in which athletes __________ to distract them from negative feelings of pain. The researchers believe that this kind of resistance to pain is something that can be learned over time. As athletes are often incredibly motivated to win a game or set a record in their event, they seem to be more likely to adopt these techniques.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고통의 부정적 감정에서 주의를 돌리기 위한 또 다른 전략이므로, 선수들이 '긍정적인 생각에 집중한다'는 내용이 알맞다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① give up their goals(목표를 포기하다) — 전략의 취지와 반대
❌ ② avoid all training(모든 훈련을 피하다) — 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ increase their pain(고통을 늘리다) — 흐름과 반대
✅ ④ focus on a positive thought(긍정적 생각에 집중하다) — 부정적 감정에서 주의를 돌리는 전략 ←정답
det.tip: focus on a positive thought to distract them from negative feelings = 부정적 감정에서 주의를 돌리려 긍정적 생각에 집중
